title: Electronics Supply Chain Visibility
thesis: Snowflake builds end-to-end electronics supply chain visibility — Dynamic Tables track 200 suppliers, ML.FORECAST predicts disruptions, and Iceberg shares certified data with OEM customers

talking_points: Two hundred suppliers across Vietnam, China, Korea, and Japan feeding Samsung and Apple product lines.
Delivery compliance at 97.2% — below 98% OEM requirement. Four suppliers flagged HIGH RISK.
Lead time deviation averaging 3.8 days — two critical components with single-source dependency.
tabs.call_out: 97.2% delivery compliance — below 98% OEM target, 4 suppliers HIGH RISK

transition.line: Let's drill into which components are at risk.

talking_points: 5,000 BOM items tracked — 12 critical components with single-source or China-only supply.
ML.FORECAST predicts 2 suppliers trending toward SLA breach in next 30 days.
Quality DPPM at 45 across all suppliers — below 50 threshold but trending up.
tabs.call_out: 12 single-source components — ML predicts 2 suppliers trending to breach

transition.line: The ML signal is clear. Let's see OEM customer view.

talking_points: Samsung requires 98% on-time, Apple 99% — current performance: Samsung 97.8%, Apple 96.5%.
Iceberg Tables enable OEM customers to audit supply chain data via Athena — self-service.
Apple audit finding: 3 tier-2 suppliers missing labor compliance certificates.
tabs.call_out: Apple audit: 3 suppliers non-compliant — fix before quarterly review

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system.

talking_points: Nguyen asks: 'Which suppliers are flagged high risk?'
Cortex Analyst queries — returns 4 suppliers with risk details.
Follow-up: 'What mitigation options exist for our single-source components?' — agent advises.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: supply chain analytics + strategic advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake SQL, open Iceberg.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Vietnam electronics exports: USB in 2023 — Samsung's largest global production base.
Iceberg enables OEM customer self-service audit access without data copies.
tabs.call_out: One platform, OEM-grade compliance, open Iceberg for audits

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — supply chain visibility for electronics manufacturing.
